title: ContextWindowAlignmentDrift: A Benchmark for Measuring Alignment Property Degradation Over Long Contexts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear causal chain: if alignment properties degrade over long contexts, single-turn safety evaluations are systematically insufficient. Demonstrating this gap directly motivates changes to how safety benchmarks are designed and applied.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Conceptually straightforward: embed existing safety probes at different context positions, measure refusal/truthfulness rates. Uses existing datasets (SORRY-Bench, TruthfulQA) and requires only API calls or a single open-weight model. Beginners can implement this with basic Python.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment with a clear independent variable (context position/length) and dependent variable (alignment metric). Deliverable is a decay curve. Achievable in 30 hours with one or two models and existing probe datasets.
